standard_prerequisites.name: Tautness of a continuous homomorphism of linearly topologized rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives openness and the fundamental-system property for the closures of the I_n B.

standard_prerequisites.name: Weakly pre-adic topological rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes what has to be produced for B: an ideal whose power closures are open and form a fundamental system.

core_obligations: Choose an ideal I of the weakly pre-adic source A whose power closures I_n are open and form a fundamental system of open ideals (proof lines 1747-1749).
Identify the closure of I^n B with the closure of I_n B (proof line 1750).
Apply tautness to conclude that these closures are open and form a fundamental system of open ideals of B (proof lines 1750-1752).
Conclude that B is weakly pre-adic (proof line 1752).
proof_roadmap: Choose the witnessing ideal in the source (proof lines 1747-1749).
Tautness gives the fundamental system in the target (proof lines 1750-1752).
difficulty_reason: For a taut continuous homomorphism of linearly topologized rings with weakly pre-adic source, the lemma asserts that the target is weakly pre-adic (statement lines 1740-1745). The proof exhibits the ideal that witnesses the property: an ideal I of A whose power closures I_n are open and form a fundamental system is chosen, the closure of I^n B is identified with the closure of I_n B, and tautness then says these closures are open and form a fundamental system of open ideals of B, which is exactly weak pre-adicity (proof lines 1747-1752). The level is H2: the comparison of the two closures is the point, and it is stated, with the rest read off from the definition.
